text: I opened the window to let in the morning air.
There is a small notebook beside my cup.
Let us take a short walk before lunch.
The quiet path leads to a little garden.
I will bring some water for the trip.
We can choose a different route tomorrow.
Please give me a moment to write this down.
Learning a little every day makes a difference.
I heard the rain while I was reading.
The sky became clear in the afternoon.
We have enough time to try once more.
translation: 한 번 더 해 볼 시간이 충분해요.

text: I am ready to begin the next chapter.
